name: M-VAVE FM-1 (Skiff firmware)
firmware: Skiff 2.2 (2026-11-03); the online manual still describes the 1.3-era MIDI menu

midiIn.connector: USB class-compliant MIDI in/out and a 3.5 mm TRS MIDI in on the FM-1
midiIn.note: TRS type not stated by Skiff or M-VAVE. In this rig a Skiff unit can take its channel directly (T1 CHANNEL = its channel, T2..T6 OFF) on any port; the H4MIDI filter is not needed but harmless.

clock.syncs: the sequencer: Clock, Start, Continue, Stop and (2.2) Song Position from the chosen input
clock.setting: MENU > MIDI > CLOCK = USB or TRS (the port Classic Tabby arrives on); CLOCK OUT off

channelSetting: MENU > MIDI > T1 CHANNEL = the unit's channel (2 for FM-1 A, 3 for FM-1 B), T2..T6 CHANNEL = OFF (2.2); MIDI IN shows TRACK. Older firmware: give T2..T6 channels nothing sends on.

channel.note: MENU > MIDI: T1..T6 CHANNEL = 1..16, OFF or CH n EXT per track (2.2); a channel no track is on is ignored entirely; two tracks on one channel: the first plays it; MIDI IN = SEL makes every channel play the selected track; AUTO CHANNEL (2.2) plays the selected track from one extra channel. Wrong Room: FM-1 A channel 2, FM-1 B channel 3.

programChange.note: Skiff 1.3+ (2.2 unchanged): a PC on a track's channel loads that track's engine's factory sound number n, counted from 0 (the PRESETS list order, aliases skipped; 0 on an FM6 track = TINE EP); a program past the engine's last preset is ignored, not wrapped; user sounds are not reachable; the load happens in the main loop after the message. No bank select (CC 0 / CC 32 ignored). The number means a different sound per engine, so name presets per engine in the rig profile.

controllers.name: Engine brightness (cutoff / DCW / tone / FM6 modulator level)

setup: Load Skiff 2.2 (web installer); MENU > MIDI > T1 CHANNEL = the unit's channel (2 or 3), T2..T6 CHANNEL = OFF.
MENU > MIDI > CLOCK = USB or TRS (where Classic Tabby arrives) so the unit follows clock, Start and Stop; CLOCK OUT = off (Classic Tabby is the master).
Program numbers count the track's engine's factory presets from 0: set track 1's engine first.
A PC is applied by the main loop after the message: keep a small gap before the notes (no published figure).
No H4MIDI filter is needed for a Skiff unit; one is harmless.
notes: 148 factory sounds over 14 engines (per-engine order in firmware/src/engines.c); no complete published name list, so presets are named in the rig profile.

Skiff 2.2 (2026-11-03) at research time: adds T CHANNEL OFF and CH n EXT, AUTO CHANNEL, NOTES OUT, CC OUT, THRU, REMOTE (CC 102..115 on its own channel press the panel buttons), CLOCK OUT, Song Position in.
